live_owner_readiness.source_diagnosis: The serialized Richards backend temporal error is binary bitwise identity only: zero for exact full-step versus two-half physical-state identity and huge(real64) otherwise.

classification.reason: Changing the fixture to make both physical trials stationary would remove the distinct predictor/corrector head path that F-GC02 is required to qualify. The independently admitted F-MR11/F-VQ26 capability is insufficient for the requested physical predictor-corrector composition, and live F-MR16 independently confirms that the current serialized Richards temporal comparator has no graded acceptance for genuinely evolving Richards states.

runtime_rejection_subclassification.claim_limit: The F-GC02 workflow log proves only predictor_result%completed=false after source locks and compilation pass. It does not expose whether the first local rejection counter was solver, temporal or mass. F-GC02 therefore does not invent that counter-level attribution.
